title: Transferring funds to another bank
summary: Explains how to transfer funds to another bank: initiate an external transfer to a destination account and enter the amount, ensuring available balance covers it when scheduled. Standard external transfers complete in 3 business days. Via EveryonePay, you can send up to $2,500 per day for instant person-to-person delivery when eligible.
